title: A reopen right after a resolve is saved (201) but the incident stays Resolved
what_happens: Reopen, resolve, reopen on one incident within two minutes: the last reopen answers 201 with the old decision id, and the incident still reads Resolved. The model-based run found it as approve, reopen after an earlier resolve.
what_should_happen: The last decision wins: the incident is Open again. The double-click guard should only skip a repeat when nothing else was decided in between.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/model-lifecycle.test.ts (server on 3142); case TIMECONC-1 (it.fails)
root_cause_guess: src/app/api/collector/decisions/route.ts, the 'recent' query: it matches the same decision by the same person in the last 2 minutes and ignores a different decision recorded after it

title: 'how many complaints yesterday' gives 133 where the calendar day 5 Nov has 150 in the stored data
what_happens: With the console now at 6 Nov 18:08 (and at 23:59 IST), the answer is 133 complaints in 115 incidents, labelled 'yesterday (5 Nov)'. The oracle gets 150 for 5 Nov 00:00 to 6 Nov 00:00 IST, and 148 for the rolling 24-48 hours. No window tried gives 133 (checked whole-hour shifts from -12 to +12).
what_should_happen: The count for the labelled day, from the same rows the console uses.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/assistant/fastpath.ts customWindow range (about line 694) or the code that counts a range; not traced

title: 'this week', 'last week', 'this month' and 'last month' all mean rolling windows, and 'last week' equals 'this week'
what_happens: 'this week' and 'last week' both answer 787 'last 7 days'. 'this month' and 'last month' both answer 3,255 'last 30 days'.
what_should_happen: 'last week' is the week before this one; 'last month' the previous calendar month. If rolling windows are meant, the answer should not call them by two different names.
repro: POST /api/collector/assistant/chat with each phrase on a server at the frozen moment
evidence: observed on port 3141 at the first probe; same headlines in docs/qa/pass4/evidence/time-travel.json
root_cause_guess: src/lib/assistant/fastpath.ts: only 'yesterday' has its own window

title: The embedding model file fails to load: 'Protobuf parsing failed'
what_happens: Every server log has the line '[assistant] embedding index: Load model ... multilingual-e5-base/onnx/model_quantized.onnx failed:Protobuf parsing failed.' (the file is probably a git LFS pointer or a cut download in this worktree).
what_should_happen: The model loads, or the app says plainly that meaning-based search is off.
repro: start any server and read data/aws-cache/qa/run/srv-3142.log
